Body.Content:
What and why

To simplify the Brand Kit creation experience in Microsoft PowerPoint, Brand Guidelines and Style are no longer available when creating new Brand Kits. These components are not currently used by Copilot and removing them streamlines the setup experience for users who create and manage Brand Kits.

Existing Brand Kits that already contain Brand Guidelines or Style retain this information and previously added content remains available.

Rollout schedule

  • As of late September 2026, Brand Guidelines and Style are no longer available when creating new Brand Kits in Microsoft PowerPoint.

Impact on your organization

Who is affected

  • Users who create or use Brand Kits in Microsoft PowerPoint
  • Brand managers and other users responsible for managing organizational branding assets

Platforms and services

  • Microsoft PowerPoint

What will happen

  • Users creating a new Brand Kit no longer see options to add Brand Guidelines or Style during setup.
  • Existing Brand Kits are not affected.
  • Brand Guidelines and Style previously added to existing Brand Kits remain available.
  • No existing Brand Kit content is removed.
  • No admin configuration or policy changes are required.

Action required and recommendations

No action is required.

We recommend that you:

  • Inform brand managers and users who create Brand Kits that Brand Guidelines and Style are no longer available during new Brand Kit creation.
  • Update any internal documentation, training materials, or support content that references adding Brand Guidelines or Style during new Brand Kit creation.
  • Reassure users that existing Brand Kits are not affected and that previously added Brand Guidelines and Style content remains available.

Learn more

We will provide additional communication if there are future changes to this experience.

Compliance considerations

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
